company.name: SynthFlow AI
company.shortDescription: Synthflow AI empowers businesses to build customizable, no-code AI voice assistants that handle a variety of tasks.
company.description: Synthflow AI is a platform that enables businesses and creators to harness the power of conversational AI and voice technology. The company provides a no-code environment where users can design, deploy, and manage AI agents tailored to their unique requirements, delivering personalized experiences that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.

productsAndServices.description: A no-code, end-to-end platform for designing, testing, deploying, and managing AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer conversations.

productsAndServices.description: Implementation and operational services that help enterprises move AI voice agents from design to production, including workflow configuration, testing, launch, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise telephony service for routing and delivering AI-powered calls through Synthflow’s communications infrastructure or a customer’s existing carrier, SIP trunk, PBX, or contact-center system.

productsAndServices.description: A white-label offering that enables BPOs, CRM providers, SaaS companies, and other partners to embed branded AI voice automation into their own products or client services.
productsAndServices.name: White-Label and Embedded Voice AI
